newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH says DFS 1996 operating result down.
newsitem.headline: LVMH says DFS 1996 operating result down.

text.p: French luxury goods group LVMH said on Monday that the provisional operating result for DFS, the U.S. duty-free chain recently acquired by the group, would be 1.73 billion francs ($302.7 million) in 1996, down from the previous year.
It reiterated, however, that the impact of the integration of DFS would be positive at the net pre-exceptional level before amortization of goodwill.

LVMH said extraordinary charges for 1996 would come to 650 million francs ($113.7 million) , due mainly to the impact of the recent sale of a third of its shares in British drinks group Guinness. ($ = 5.714 French Francs)
